toolbar.quickTip: Global build settings — in sync with Settings → Build
toolbar.editInProject: Read-only · edit in project settings (✎ on the left)
toolbar.contextDefaultTip: No project context dir set: each program builds from its Dockerfile's directory (a program-level context wins; a project context dir wins over the Dockerfile dir)
toolbar.packExportTip: Export offline pack: bundle the base & tool images required for builds; copy it to an offline machine and import it there to build without network
toolbar.packImportTip: Import offline pack: load the images and configure the offline build environment on this machine

sidebar.title: Projects
sidebar.deleteConfirm: Delete project "{{name}}"? All programs in it will be removed too
sidebar.projectContextHint: Programs with empty context build from this directory; if left empty too, each program follows its Dockerfile's directory

export.scopeHint: Import on the offline machine is manifest-driven, independent of the export scope

env.dockerMissing: docker not found. Install Docker Desktop / Engine (auto-rechecks until ready)
env.buildxMissing: buildx not found. Upgrade Docker or enable the buildx plugin
env.daemonMissing: Docker daemon is not running. Start Docker (auto-rechecks until ready)
env.qemuFail: QEMU registration failed: {{msg}} (import the offline pack on air-gapped machines)

form.name: Project name
form.contextFollowHint: Leave empty to follow the project context dir (or the Dockerfile's dir if the project's is empty); set to override

settings.title: Global settings
settings.registry: Private registry prefix (empty if not pushing)
settings.exportArchSuffix: Arch suffix in exported file names
settings.exportArchSuffixHint: Image tags are always image:version (no time/arch). On: {image}-{version}-{arch}.tar; Off: {image}-{version}.tar. Keep it on for dual-arch builds to tell artifacts apart; off means same-name overwrite
settings.dataDirHint: Stores project config, build logs, default export dir and offline data. Applied after restart; current config migrates automatically.
settings.envDesc: Local Docker toolchain and build capabilities (same source as the top-bar Env info popover)
settings.registryDesc: Used when pushing to a registry; leave empty if not pushing
settings.namingDesc: Builder instance and export file naming rules
settings.builderNameDesc: Used only for cross-arch builds; same-arch builds use the default builder
settings.buildPresetsHint: One KEY=VALUE per line; selectable in every program's build args, same key replaces
settings.nugetDirHint: Injected as NUGET_PACKAGES build arg for all programs; empty disables

log.title: Build logs
log.empty: Logs stream here after clicking Build
log.summary: This run: {{success}} ok / {{failed}} failed / {{canceled}} canceled / {{skipped}} skipped

errors.queue_running: A build queue is already running
errors.offline_busy: An offline pack task is running; please try again later
errors.registry_not_configured: Push selected but no registry configured (fill in Settings)
errors.no_projects: Select at least one project to build
errors.no_outputs: Select at least one output destination
errors.docker_missing: docker not found. Install and start Docker first
errors.daemon_missing: Docker daemon not running. Start Docker
errors.builder_bootstrap_failed: Failed to bootstrap builder: {{msg}} (import the offline pack on air-gapped machines)
errors.dockerfile_invalid: Some projects have an invalid Dockerfile path
errors.context_invalid: Some projects have an invalid context dir
errors.saveBlocked: Config is locked while a build or offline pack task runs

about.title: About
about.desc: Cross-platform batch Docker image builder for .NET teams: queued multi-project builds, amd64/arm64 cross builds, tar export / local load / registry push, real-time logs and offline intranet support.
